title: About me
intro: <0>Hi! I'm Mari, a Web Developer,</0> with a strong focus on creating scalable, user-centric applications. I am currently completing my final year at Folkuniversitetet in Gothenburg and will be graduating in June 2026. My journey into tech is driven by a passion for bridging the gap between complex user needs and elegant technical solutions.
more1: My technical journey has led me to become a versatile developer with expertise in TypeScript, React, and Next.js, complemented by a solid understanding of backend systems like Node.js and Supabase. Most recently, I’ve been honing my skills as an intern at Nexer Group, where I worked on a collaborative team building an email builder using WebSockets.
more2: With a Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, I bring a unique human perspective to development, prioritizing accessibility, clean architecture, and empathy for the end-user. I am now looking for my next challenge where I can contribute my skills in fullstack development and agile collaboration. If you have an available position or know someone I can get in touch with, I would love to hear from you! Send me an <0>email</0> or a message on <1>LinkedIn</1>.
